name: context-keeper
description: A toast at 60% and 75% of the compaction point asks you to run /compact at the end of the task, while the cache is warm. /keeper shows the context fill. The handoff template lives in CLAUDE.md under "# Compact Instructions", because the engine skips installed mods' compaction hooks where an organization manages Claude Code. Reads token counts only. Sends nothing out and stores nothing on disk.

mode.title: Toast mode
mode.description: ask (default): a toast at the two levels asks you to run /compact. off: no toast. /keeper mode changes it for this session.

nudgeAtPercent.title: First toast (percent of the compaction point)
nudgeAtPercent.description: After an answer, the first toast shows when the context is at this percent of the compaction point.

nudgeAgainAtPercent.title: Second toast (percent of the compaction point)
nudgeAgainAtPercent.description: The second and last toast shows at this percent. The toasts start again when the context drops below the first level, as after a compaction.
